transcript.text: Hi. I was looking at your work on Instagram. I have a 2BHK in Wakad — can you tell me roughly how much something like that would cost?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Our pricing depends on the materials and the scope — the best way to get a clear picture is a consultation with one of our designers, who can walk you through everything. What are you planning to do?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Full redesign — modular kitchen, wardrobes, living room, both bedrooms. About 950 sq ft.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We move in November — so maybe starting design from October?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That works well. Shall I set up a consultation?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, but can you give me a rough ballpark first? Even a range?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I genuinely can’t — it varies quite a bit based on materials. Giving you a number without seeing the site would be misleading. The designer will go through all of that with you — the consultation is free and there’s no obligation.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay, fair enough. Let’s book it.
